title: quiet quitting in the organizational setting: a bibliometric analysis
core_idea: To analyze the main characteristics of the scholarly literature on quiet quitting by performing a bibliometric and cartographic analysis of Scopus-indexed publications, using VOSviewer to map interconnections and collaboration networks among authors, countries, institutions, and keywords to inform research activity on the phenomenon.
tldr: A bibliometric study that maps and characterizes the scholarly literature on quiet quitting using Scopus data and VOSviewer to trace collaboration and research activity.
